title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Banana Ice Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Banana Ice Nic Salt combines a mellow tropical fruit base with a icy-cool finish. The Banana is soft, sweet and creamy, offering a rich and familiar flavour. This is lifted by a cool Menthol note that adds contrast without overpowering the fruit, rounding off the profile with a brisk, refreshing edge. Formulated at a 50VG/50PG ratio, Crystal Clear Banana Ice Nic Salt is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with low-powered pod kits and vape pens. Itâ€™s available in both 10mg and 20mg strengths, ensuring a smooth throat hit with quick and effective nicotine delivery. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
